tagline.en: US eSIM brand with cruise and offshore coverage, Visa partnership
tagline.zh: 美国 eSIM 品牌，含邮轮与海上覆盖，Visa 合作

description.en: GigSky is a US eSIM brand (founded 2010 era) selling country, regional, global and cruise plans - one of the few with explicit offshore/cruise coverage. Its homepage states an "Official Visa Partner" relationship and entry prices from $2.99.
description.zh: GigSky 是美国 eSIM 品牌（2010 年前后创立），销售单国、区域、全球与邮轮套餐——是少数明确提供海上/邮轮覆盖的品牌。首页标注「Official Visa Partner」合作关系，入门价 $2.99 起。

zh: Visa 官方合作关系（站点标注）
有 GigSky Rewards 积分计划

details.en:
GigSky is a US eSIM brand (founded around 2010, over a decade of operation) differentiated in two scenarios: cruise and offshore coverage (its nav carries Countries/Regions/Cruises & Offshore categories) and an "Official Visa Partner" relationship stated on the homepage, alongside a GigSky Rewards program. Directories put coverage at 193 countries.

Prices: homepage rendered 2026-11-10 with entry plans from $2.99 (multiple $2.99 tiles). Destination pages use a different URL scheme and were not captured this pass - per-country prices to be verified later.

Who it fits: cruise passengers (connectivity at sea is a scarce capability) and users needing connectivity beyond ordinary destinations.

Notes: entry pricing sits slightly above reseller brands; management is app-first; per-destination networks are not disclosed.

Follow-up (2026-11-11): the Japan page lists an unlimited plan at $3.32/day and fixed tiers in the $3.49-$14.99 band (tier sizes not labeled on-page).
details.zh:
GigSky 是美国 eSIM 品牌（2010 年前后创立，运营十余年），差异化在两类场景：邮轮与海上覆盖（Countries/Regions/Cruises & Offshore 四类目）和 Visa 官方合作关系（首页标注「Official Visa Partner」，并附 GigSky Rewards 积分计划）。目录口径覆盖 193 国。

价格：2026-11-10 渲染首页实核入门套餐 $2.99 起（多个 $2.99 卡片同现）。目的地价目页采用不同 URL 结构，本轮未抓取，逐国价格待补核。

适合人群：邮轮乘客（海上有网是稀缺能力）、需要常规目的地之外（如海上作业、离岸场景）联网的用户。

注意：入门价略高于转售品牌；管理以 App 为主；未按目的地披露底层网络。

补充（2026-11-11）：日本页显示不限量套餐 $3.32/天，定额档位在 $3.49-14.99 区间（页面未标注各档 GB 数）。
